# Reverend Ez

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c24 P3](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0003), [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** clergyman and theology student  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v4 c3 P10](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0010), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)</sub>
- **Titles:** Reverend  <sub>[v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)</sub>; Mr. Hale  <sub>[v3 c26 P11](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0011), [v3 c29 P6](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0006)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Ezra Hale  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>; Ezra  <sub>[v3 c24 P3](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0003), [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>; Ez  <sub>[v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

He is described as extremely unattractive, possessing a large, gangly frame with elongated legs. He has flaxen, limp hair, green eyes, a large mouth, and conspicuous ears. On ordinary days, his unkempt hair conceals a scholarly forehead, but he possesses impassioned eyes and a voice that is charming and delightful.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010), [v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015)_

## Personality

Ezra has an unquestionable beauty of soul and nature, radiating a charm that makes him delightful company. He is serious, gentle, faithful, and embodies all that a clergyman should be. He enjoys laughing and joking, and he understands and affectionate accepts others despite their perceived flaws.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021)_

## History

Ezra graduated from Wexcombe and studied theology at St. Columbia. Although he resisted the idea of becoming a minister for a long time, he eventually accepted it as his assigned calling. Over a summer, he took charge of the Point Prospect Mission Church, where he stayed as a roomer alongside Cressida Lindsay and four elderly women. He quickly became close friends with Cressida, enjoying boating, fishing, and moonlight walks with her. Despite initial hesitation due to his lack of wealth, he won her affections and later visited her parents at Mount Holly, ultimately securing their love and approval. They were married the following June. Later, he offered a wedding prayer at the marriage ceremony of Hugh and Nell.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P3](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0003), [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 c26 P11](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0011), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021), [v3 c29 P6](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0006), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)_
